content.text: Why This Infrastructure Works When Platforms Fail: Nowpayments digital

NOWPayments is not a workaround or a hack. It's a base-layer infrastructure that gives you full control over your payment processing. Unlike Stripe, which can freeze your account at any time, NOWPayments allows you to collect payments directly on your website, without relying on any third-party platform. This means you can avoid the fees, restrictions, and delays that come with using platforms like Gumroad or Stripe.
What You Need Before You Deploy

Before you can deploy NOWPayments, you'll need to set up a few things. First, you'll need to create a NOWPayments account and get your API keys. Next, you'll need to choose a network and configure your payment settings. You'll also need to set up a delivery pipeline to handle product delivery and order storage. Don't worry, we'll walk you through each of these steps in detail.
Setting Up Your Payment and Delivery Pipeline

To set up your payment and delivery pipeline, you'll need to integrate NOWPayments with your website. This involves adding a payment button to your website and configuring your payment settings. You'll also need to set up a delivery pipeline to handle product delivery and order storage. We recommend using Supabase or Google Sheets for order storage and Google Drive or Cloudflare R2 for file delivery.
With NOWPayments, you can collect payments directly on your website, without relying on any third-party platform.
Going Live and Processing Your First Transaction

The fee structure of NOWPayments is fundamentally different from conventional platform fees. NOWPayments charges 0.5% per transaction. There is no monthly fee, no setup fee, no payout fee, and no minimum transaction volume requirement. Network fees for the underlying blockchain transaction are paid by the buyer and vary by network — Tron fees are under $0.10, Solana fees are fractions of a cent, Bitcoin fees average $1 to $5 for most transactions. For a $97 product sold through the Sovereign Starter Stack, the total transaction cost is approximately $0.49 to NOWPayments plus network fees typically under $0.10 on Tron. Compare this to Gumroad's 10% fee on the same transaction — $9.70.
Scaling Once the Infrastructure Is Running

The transaction log in a COREMERCH deployment provides a complete, independently verifiable audit trail of every payment. Each entry includes the transaction hash, which links directly to the public blockchain record. You can verify any transaction independently on Tronscan, Etherscan, Solscan, or the relevant blockchain explorer — no platform intermediary required. If a buyer claims they paid but the transaction does not appear in your order log, you check the blockchain directly. This level of cryptographic verifiability is structurally impossible with conventional payment processors.
How to setup NOWPayments?

USDT is the most practical starting point for digital product sales because it eliminates price volatility from the equation. Your buyer pays in USDT and you receive USDT — one dollar in equals one dollar received, minus the Tron network fee of under $0.10 per transaction and the NOWPayments fee of 0.5%. You do not need to manage exchange rate risk or time your conversions around market movements. When you are ready to convert to local currency, you use a P2P exchange — Binance P2P operates in most countries where conventional payment platforms are unavailable and supports competitive local currency rates.
NOWPayments supports 300+ cryptocurrencies, including USDT on Tron and Solana, which costs under $0.10 per transaction in network fees.

Set up a delivery pipeline to handle product delivery and order storage. Integrate NOWPayments with your website. Configure your payment settings and webhooks. Test your payment flow and verify your payment receipts. Monitor your performance and optimize your payment flow.
